newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah edges up on overnight rises.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah edges up on overnight rises.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah edged up against the dollar at close following a sudden turnaround in the money market, dealers said.
One local bank dealer said some banks were squeezed late in the afternoon, forcing them to absorb overnight rupiah at 23 percent, compared with afternoon rates of around 5.5 percent.
"It's not clear what was the reason. It might be due to some unexpected large withdrawals or mismatches," he said.
Dealers said liquidity had been ample the whole day and were unclear of the sudden revision in the market. They were also unsure whether it was linked to Tuesday tax payments.
"The market is usually thin in the afternoon. Any large amount coming in would easily move the market," another said.
"This might have psychological carry-forward impact for Tuesday," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah strengthened slightly to 2,395.0/96.0 at 1025 GMT, compared with 2,396.75/97.00 at 0900 GMT and the opening level of 2,3997.25/98.00.
One-month swaps were at 9.75/10.25, two at 21.25/22.75, three at 33.5/34.5 and six at 71.75/73.00 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,383/2,575 and the conversion band to 2,383/2,431 on Monday after depreciating the rupiah by two points last week.
